narrative:
The demand plan covers ~25.9M units across the ten key product line × region combinations. The Cortex ML forecast (91% accuracy vs 85% for the manual plan) blends ACDOCA sell-in history, retail POS signals and promotion calendars.

Seasonality is pronounced: floorcare and coffee machines peak in Nov–Dec, fridge-freezers in May–Aug. The agent flags upside for Bosch Unlimited cordless vacuums and downside for China multi-door fridge-freezers as trade-in subsidies taper.

Volumes approved here drive plant loading in Step 4 automatically — no spreadsheet hand-off between Sales and Manufacturing Controlling.

signals.title: European Home Appliance Market Outlook
signals.excerpt: European MDA market flat to +1% in 2026 after two years of decline; premium built-in segment recovering faster than freestanding. China competition intensifying in entry price points.

signals.title: BP Process Overview — Manual Entry Hotspots
signals.excerpt: Every step of the business planning process involves manual data entry or adjustments in SAC and Excel. Actuals are re-keyed from BW E0P; volume and price assumptions are emailed between controllers.
